# Pulse Hospital & I.C.U, Modasa

> Pulse Hospital & I.C.U (પલ્સ હોસ્પિટલ એન્ડ આઈ.સી.યુ.) is a 41-bed hospital for 24x7 emergency and critical care on the 4th floor of City Centre, Shamlaji Road, Modasa, Aravalli district, Gujarat, India. It has a 30-bed critical care department with ventilators, an in-house CT scan, a 24x7 dialysis unit, a 24x7 laboratory and pharmacy, and modular operation theatres, with MD physicians, a DM cardiologist and a chest physician.

## Contact
- Address: 4th Floor, A-block, City Centre, Shamlaji Road, Modasa, Aravalli - 383315, Gujarat, India
- Emergency, appointments and WhatsApp: +91 95120 45641 / +91 95120 45642

- Emergency, ICU, dialysis, laboratory and pharmacy: open 24 hours, every day
- OPD: Mon – Sat · 09:00 AM – 01:30 PM & 04:30 PM – 08:00 PM
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?q=City+Centre+Shamlaji+Road+Modasa+Gujarat
- Website: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/

## Departments and conditions treated

### Critical Care & ICU
For patients whose life is at risk and who need round-the-clock monitoring, ventilator support or organ support.
- Conditions: Sepsis & septic shock, Respiratory failure, Multi-organ failure, Post-surgery ICU care, Severe poisoning
- Services: Ventilator support, Central monitoring, Bedside dialysis, Isolation ICU
- Page: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments#critical-care

### General & Internal Medicine
The starting point for most adult illnesses: diagnosis, long-term disease control and fever care.
- Conditions: Uncontrolled diabetes, Thyroid disorders, High blood pressure, Dengue with low platelets, Malaria & typhoid, Chikungunya
- Services: OPD consultation, Lab work-ups, Admission if needed
- Page: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments#medicine

### Heart & Cardio-Metabolic Care
Emergency and ongoing care for the heart, blood pressure and related metabolic conditions.
- Conditions: Heart attack, Hypertensive crisis, Heart failure, Cholesterol & metabolic disease, Arrhythmia & valve disorders
- Services: Consultation with DM Cardiologist, 2D Echo & Doppler, I.C.C.U. (cardiac ICU), Cardiac troponin testing, Angiography guidance
- Page: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments#cardiac

### Chest & Pulmonology
Everything to do with the lungs and breathing: from long-term asthma to ICU ventilation.
- Conditions: Breathlessness, Pneumonia, Fluid in the lungs, Asthma, COPD, Sleep apnoea, Post-COVID lung fibrosis
- Services: Bronchoscopy, PFT / spirometry, Sleep study, HRCT chest
- Page: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments#chest

### Kidney Care & Dialysis
Diagnosis and treatment of kidney disease, with a dialysis unit that is open around the clock.
- Conditions: Kidney stones, Kidney swelling, Urinary infection, Acute renal failure
- Services: Emergency dialysis, Maintenance dialysis, ICU bedside dialysis
- Page: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments#kidney

### Liver & Stomach (Gastro)
Care for the digestive system and liver, supported by endoscopy.
- Conditions: Jaundice, Diarrhoea & vomiting, Bowel inflammation, Bleeding in the stomach
- Services: Endoscopy, Gastroenterology & hepatology, Abdominal CT & sonography
- Page: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments#gastro

### Brain & Stroke Care
Fast diagnosis and treatment for stroke and other brain emergencies; the in-house CT saves critical minutes.
- Conditions: Paralysis (stroke), Brain haemorrhage, Fits / seizures, Encephalitis (brain fever)
- Services: Emergency brain CT, Stroke thrombolysis, Neuro / spine surgery
- Page: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments#neuro

### Emergency, Trauma & Poisoning
Immediate care for accidents, bites and poisoning. Walk in any time: no appointment needed.
- Conditions: Road accident injuries, Burns, Electric shock, Heat stroke, Snakebite, Insect bites, Pesticide / drug poisoning
- Services: 24x7 casualty desk, 24x7 emergency ambulance, Anti-snake venom, Antidote protocols, Trauma surgery
- Page: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments#emergency

### Surgery
Planned and emergency operations in modular theatres, including keyhole, orthopaedic, spine and jaw surgery.
- Conditions: Fractures, Abdominal surgery, Hernia & gallbladder, Spine problems, Jaw & dental surgery
- Services: General surgery, High-risk surgery, Laparoscopic surgery, Orthopaedic surgery with IITV, Neuro & spine surgery, Plastic surgery, Maxillofacial surgery
- Page: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments#surgery

## Facilities

- Intensive Care Unit (ICU) (24x7): 30-bed comprehensive critical care unit comprising 15 ICCU beds, 7 MICU beds, 7 SICU beds and 1 isolation bed with ventilators and central monitoring.
- Isolation ICU (24x7): A dedicated 1-bed glass-walled, separately entered isolation ICU room protecting contagious patients and hospital surroundings.
- Emergency & Trauma (24x7): A casualty desk with an immediate doctor response for accidents, poisoning, snakebite, burns, stroke and high fever.
- Nursing Station & Central Monitoring (24x7): Experienced ICU nurses watch every bed's vitals on a central screen and respond within moments.
- 24x7 Dialysis Unit: Emergency and scheduled haemodialysis, supported by high-grade dialysis machines and a dedicated RO water purification plant.
- In-House CT Scan (24x7): Modasa CT Scan Centre on the same premises with high-precision gantry and technician workstation, requiring zero transfer delay.
- 24x7 Pathology Laboratory: Automated blood testing machines, cell counter and sample counter operating 24 hours so treatment is never delayed.
- Digital X-Ray, 2D Echo & Sonography (24x7): Heart ultrasound, abdominal sonography and digital X-ray, including portable machines that come to the bed.
- Lung Function & Bronchoscopy Lab: Specialist lung testing led by the chest physician: bronchoscopy, spirometry and sleep studies.
- Modular Operation Theatre (24x7): Sterile modular theatres with laminar airflow, LED surgical lights and a full anaesthesia workstation.
- Laparoscopy, Endoscopy & Specialty Surgery: Keyhole surgery and camera procedures, plus neuro/spine and maxillofacial (dental) surgical wings.
- Super Deluxe & Deluxe Rooms (24x7): 3 private air-conditioned deluxe rooms for quiet recovery, with attached bathroom and dedicated attendant space.
- Special & Twin-Sharing Rooms (24x7): 3 curtained twin-sharing patient rooms with the same central medical fittings and motorised beds as private rooms.
- Consultation Rooms (OPD): Private consulting rooms with an examination couch, where you meet your doctor for a booked 30-minute slot.
- Physiotherapy Department: Rehabilitation that helps patients get moving again after surgery, a stroke, a fracture or a long ICU stay.
- 24x7 Pharmacy: An in-house medical store that stays open all night, so prescriptions never wait for morning.
- Reception, Billing & Waiting Lounge (24x7): A calm, air-conditioned arrival area with a help desk, a separate billing counter and a spacious waiting lounge.
- 24x7 Emergency Ambulance Service: Dedicated 24x7 patient pickup and transfer ambulance fitted with continuous medical oxygen, stretcher, emergency first-aid kit, and trained paramedical staff.
- 24x7 Purified Mineral Water (RO Plant): Dedicated multi-stage commercial RO water purification plant providing 100% clean, hygienic, and safe mineral drinking water across all hospital floors.
- Centralized Air Conditioning (Central AC) (24x7): Hospital-wide centralized air conditioning ensuring optimal climate control, HEPA air filtration, and dust-free healing comfort across all floors.

## Frequently asked questions

### How does advance slot booking work?
Choose a doctor, pick any day in the coming week and a 30-minute morning or evening slot. Your request opens in WhatsApp addressed to the hospital reception, and you get a booking ID (e.g. PLS-920101) and a printable slip. Reception confirms the slot on WhatsApp.

### Do I need an appointment for an emergency?
No. The emergency desk, ICU, CT scan, lab, pharmacy and dialysis run 24x7. Come straight to the 4th floor, City Centre, or call ahead so the team is ready.

### Can I check or cancel my booking?
Yes. Use “My Booking” and search with your mobile number or booking ID. It lists bookings made from this phone or computer; you can reopen the slip, or cancel, which prepares a WhatsApp message to reception so the slot can be released.

### What should I bring to my appointment?
Please bring your hospital file and all previous medical reports, any recent lab tests and prescriptions, and a photo ID.

### Where is Pulse Hospital located?
4th Floor, A-block, City Centre, Shamlaji Road, Modasa, Aravalli - 383315. Lift access, wheelchair assistance and ample parking are available.
